reply_text:
I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **ticket #4092**. Ilse posted that in #north-random on Oct 13, and Dana is a member of that channel. I also passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

- **gbrain didn't work.** It refused my search because this connection isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. Fixing that needs someone with access to the brain's host. They can bind the connection to one member with `gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <MEMBER>`. Or they can let it act for several people, with the bot naming the member on each call. Until then, I'm working from channels and files only.
- **I didn't use Dana's DM guess.** Earlier in a direct message she told me privately that she guesses the ticket will end up as OPS-5546 next year. That was a guess she asked me to keep to myself, so it stayed out of the channel reply.
